name: DirichletProcessMap

args.name: keys
args.description: The integer keys identifying the samples

args.name: alpha
args.description: The concentration parameter: larger values favor more clusters; smaller values favor sharing

args.name: dist
args.description: The base distribution on shared values

title: The integer-map Dirichlet process distribution
description:
Draw one exchangeable Dirichlet process value for each supplied integer key. The result has exactly the supplied key set, and entries assigned to the same cluster share one value drawn from `dist`.

Supports sampling and use as latent variables in MCMC, but not direct density evaluation or observation of the returned collection.
